_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture — assembled from public Spreed source, not captured from a real server. Verify against real traffic in Task 2.3. Represents ONE incoming 'offer' message as delivered by the long-poll GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v3/signaling/{token}. Spreed wraps the offer in a {type:'message', data:'<stringified JSON>'} envelope; the stringified payload's shape is {type:'offer', from:<sender_sessionId>, to:<recipient_sessionId>, roomType:'video'|'screen', payload:{type:'offer', sdp:<SDP string>}}. NOTE on roomType: Spreed uses roomType:'video' even for audio-only calls (the WebRTC connection is the same; directionality lives in the SDP m-line). Audio-only 'sendrecv' SDP m-line is shown here. Anonymized: sessionId -> 'SESSION_1'/'SESSION_2'; actorId derivable from 'from' only via a separate usersInRoom lookup; ICE IP in SDP -> 203.0.113.10 (RFC 5737 TEST-NET-3).
_outgoing_post_body_reference: When nctalk-call SENDS an offer, the POST to /signaling/{token} body is form-encoded as {messages:'<stringified [{ev:"message", fn:"<stringified payload without 'from' (server adds it)>", sessionId:"<own_sessionId>"}]>'}. See README.md for a concrete example.
